Title: No Good Deed
Description: Recover the supplies described in Huntsman Lee's requisition note and discover the fate of his porter, Riker.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [Upon closer inspection, there is a bloodstain on the letter and you hear the sound of a wolf howling not so far away. It seems someone else will need to collect supplies.]
InProgressResponse: "Hey Riker… take the cart to Fallowhill Farm and load up on whatever food and supplies you can find. The commoners of Oxboro deserve a break."
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oi,<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> you're not Riker. Better looking than that old horse-faced lout, you are.

Title: Fine Furs For Fine Folk
Description: Acquire Midnight Hides from Midnight Den to replicate Huntsman Lee's fancy jacket for inquiring noble families.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: There's old<g id="male_explain" /> money, the Publius, Sharma, and Ayad families, and then there's new money with the Sacco and Ou families.
InProgressResponse: After doing<g id="male_explain" /> your good deed for the day, it's only fitting you help yourself out, too.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, just<g id="male_smile" /> feel how plush these pelts are! They're bloody perfect.

Title: A Circle of Stars
Description: Investigate towers Orion and Draco to acquire Ancient Devices, then return them with the notes to William Heron in the Everfall Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [You spot a few hasty sketches in the margins, which appear to be diagrams of small Ancient devices.]
InProgressResponse: Most of the content in these notes is esoteric and hard to understand. Only the directions to towers Orion and Draco are clear enough to follow.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hmm? You don't look like an antiquarian. What business could you possibly have with--

Title: Stellar Research
Description: Investigate towers Perseus and Lupus, then return to William Heron to tell him what you found.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Perish the thought! You'll handle anything in the field. We will both be credited on any works I write.
InProgressResponse: From what I can glean, the Ancients place neither sun nor earth at the center of creation. Hmm.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You look a bit worse for wear. I do apologize for sending you in blind.

Title: Beacons in the Dark
Description: Investigate towers Norma, Leo, and Hercules and see if there is a way to activate them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Not particularly. I confess that at this point, you have more practical experience with the towers than I do.
InProgressResponse: I suspect that the skeletal guardians are unintelligent. Less like men, more like clockwork mindlessly ticking on.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Wait! Wait, wait, wait, wait. Your very presence caused the towers to glow?

Title: Azoth Awakening
Description: Collect Azoth Dust from Ancient Guardians at towers Canus, Ursa, and Monoceros.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: … A predictable answer. The next time you destroy them, could you bring back samples from their remains?
InProgressResponse: Surely you aren't put off by a few samples from long-dead skeletons? Hmm. Perhaps I could've phrased that better, now that I think about it…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This Azoth is only slightly contaminated with human bone dust. It will suffice.

Title: Constellation Convergence
Description: Retrieve the Armillary Sphere from the Shattered Obelisk, along with Ancient Runekeys held by its defenders. Return them to William Heron, who hopes to unlock the Armillary Sphere.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Accurate, if simple. The Ancients employed them as well, though theirs were far more complex.
InProgressResponse: I can only imagine what Aeternum looked like during the reign of the Ancients. I feel we would have gotten along swimmingly, don't you?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: At last, the armillary sphere! I'll insert the keys, and… hmm. That's unexpected.

Title: Foreman's Ledger (Expedition)
Description: Collect the Foreman's Ledger in Amrine Excavation. Report back to William Heron in the Everfall Settlement when your task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Simon led the expedition into the Amrine Excavation of Windsward many years ago, and never returned.
InProgressResponse: The Amrine Excavation is a dangerous digsite, so you will likely need friends to safely explore it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is that it? His ledger? Fantastic! With this, I can learn a great deal!

Title: Starstone of Shattering (Expedition)
Description: Collect the Starstone Diadem from Greundgul the Regent inside the Shattered Obelisk. Report back to William Heron in the Everfall Settlement when your task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, the Foreman's notes suggest the existence of a side entrance that could actually allow a small group to get inside.
InProgressResponse: Oh, the possibilities! We could be unearthing an artifact that helps us fight the Corrupted, or at the very least gives us insight into the Ancients.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This is truly a momentous find. This Starstone Diadem seems to have denoted an Ancient Guardian of incredibly high ranking, a ruler of some sort!

Title: Dishonorable Daughter
Description: Venture into Arcturus to recover an item of equal value to the one Tamra Ayad destroyed in her home estate, and return the item to Tamra Ayad.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Everyone! After what I've done. In my clumsiness, I knocked over and shattered grandmother's favorite vase.
InProgressResponse: Look for anything valuable, large, pristine, or beautiful. Going back to my family depends upon it. S-Sorry. No pressure…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Look at that, what a beauty! This will definitely get me back in grandmother's good graces! You've saved my life, friend.

Title: Curious Child
Description: Bring the Ancient Scrolls to Tamra Ayad to assess their value.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [You pick up the writings and decide to bring them to Tamra Ayad, the woman who asked you to find a vase in Arcturus.]
InProgressResponse: [The scrolls sit waiting to be taken to someone who understands their value.]
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What's this? More Ancient relics? Oh! Writings!

Title: An Heir Transformed
Description: Venture into the Varangian camp to recover the stolen Ancient relics for Tamra Ayad.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Not just the vase. I feel… this place better suits me. Finally, I can explore my own interests!
InProgressResponse: I doubt the knights will part with their finds willingly.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh my! You recovered so many! They must have been hoarding these like squirrels.

Title: Canary in the Corrupted Mine
Description: Scout the land of Canary Mine to investigate the Corrupted threat.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The kind<g id="female_nodding" /> that can take what you value most, so you best keep your wits about you.
InProgressResponse: I have<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> been developing this poison ever since… Well, I shall not burden you with a sob story when we've only just become acquainted.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The earth<g id="female_rightfistThreaten" /> of Canary Mine will yield no more for the Corrupted. Good. Let them starve. Let them feel the sting of privation.

Title: Salting the Earth
Description: Poison the earth of Ebonrock Cavern and Ebonrock Quarry while taking down as many Corrupted as you can for Tekla Petrowski.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Then they<g id="female_disappointed" /> are fools. Corruption is real, it is here, and it will take so much more from us than we could ever expect.
InProgressResponse: The quarry<g id="female_nodding" />  and cavern used to be some of the most prosperous mines in Everfall.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It is done.<g id="female_nodding" /> All my poison has been used, and it will take months to create a new batch.

Title: Tekla's Tragedy
Description: Venture to the Everfall Settlement to discuss the Corrupted incursion with Huntsman Odnell Lee.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Odnell Lee<g id="female_nodding" /> is a friend. He may play every political side in Everfall, but he has proven trustworthy when it counts. Go speak to him.
InProgressResponse: We used<g id="female_nodding" /> to be closer, Lee and I. That was when… Nevermind.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Wait… <g id="male_whattheheckBig" />you're saying that Tekla did what to the mines?! Oh, my… I have a terrible feeling this is about Audrey.

Title: Avenging Audrey
Description: Shame the Corrupted forces occupying Kelleher's Farmstead by taking out the Lieutenants and speak to Tekla Petrowski.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: So, Lee<g id="female_disappointed" /> told you about Audrey… Yes, this is for her. She was killed in her own home and never came back.
InProgressResponse: Audrey<g id="female_disappointed" /> was too good for this island. Too good for this world.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So the<g id="female_smackfist" /> lieutenants have been defeated. Good. They deserve much worse, but this will suffice for now.

Title: Bittersweet Memory
Description: Return the Lost Locket to Tekla Petrowski.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [You pocket the locket with the intent of showing it to Tekla Petrowski.]
InProgressResponse: [The locket is dusty and lonely. Perhaps it will find a new home with Tekla Petrowski.]
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What are<g id="female_lookforwardWonder" /> you holding? Could it be…? I thought the locket was lost forever. <g id="female_sobbing" />Thank you for finding it. Oh, my Audrey...

Title: The Lovers' Flowers
Description: Touched by your return of the locket, Tekla Petrowski wishes for you to gather a bouquet of Meadowlake Flowers at Meadowlake Fishery to remember Audrey.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: No.<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> It is too painful. But if you find yourself heading in the direction of Meadowlake Fishery perhaps you could gather a bouquet for her? He he!
InProgressResponse: I have<g id="female_nodding" /> already asked so much of you, but here I am, asking for the tiniest bit of comfort.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Your willingness<g id="female_nodding" /> to help a stranger has taught me much.

Title: Lee's Condolences
Description: Relay what has happened with Tekla Petrowski to Odnell Lee in the Everfall Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hmm…<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> Not today. But perhaps tomorrow, or the day after that.
InProgressResponse: Lee is<g id="female_nodding" /> a kind man, and he's fussed over me ever since I lost Audrey to the Corrupted.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You're back!<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" /> You must've done something incredible to soothe the tempest in Tekla's heart.

Title: The Magnum Opus
Description: Longing to rise above his station as a butler, Atticus Delphi wishes to share his musical talents with the world. With so many instruments to choose from, he is struck with a moment of indecision.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Alas, I should have chosen a more private locale for this.
InProgressResponse: A guitar may very well be suitable, but I will know the true voice of my work when I hear it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ahhh… there it is. The flute produces the most whimsical sound. I can elicit soul-stirring melodies from such an instrument.

Title: Reputation is Everything
Description: What good is a composition if it goes unheard? Play the Magnum Opus throughout the town in a grand debut as a composer!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I cannot be the one to deliver my work unto the world. To gain a reputation for being a GREAT composer, we must create the impression that my music has spread far and wide.
InProgressResponse: If you want to embellish a little, perhaps you could also mention how prolific my work is.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: How did it go? Did they like it? Did their eyes shine? Perhaps shed a tear?

Title: It's Who You Know
Description: With his reputation growing with each passing day, now is the time to seek a patron. One does not simply approach the patriarch of a great house on a whim, however…
PlayerPrompt: "Harsh. What are you going to do?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Find a patron without her, obviously. She does not own me.
InProgressResponse: There are other avenues, but they are less socially acceptable.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I detect triumph in your demeanor. I do not know what you had to do to secure this opportunity for me, but I suspect victory is close at hand.

Title: Everyone has a Price
Description: The great family Sacco will not be humiliated so easily. With Atticus bound to his contractual duties, his patron may be the only one who can set him free to practice his craft.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Thank you… my heart is all aflutter. Perhaps you could act as my associate and accompany me?
InProgressResponse: I am so nervous I could sweat through my socks. How humiliating would that be?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You return. Well? Shall I deliver the good news to Atticus?

Title: Ever Been Mauled?
Description: Felix Livius challenges you to "wrestle" a bear for the raw thrill of it all.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Almost every day! It's a great way to wake yourself up, squaring up with a fuzzy behemoth of nature.
InProgressResponse: Still hanging around here? You ought to be wrestling a bear, and we both know it. Scared?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Haha! You've done it! Good for you, showing some true brawn.

Title: Bragging Rights
Description: Talk to Huntsman Lee in the Everfall Settlement about your bear experience.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ha ha! I'm just an enthusiast. Odnell, though? Cares too much about appearances. But Aeternum's full of all sorts.
InProgressResponse: Lost, are we? Huntsman Lee is in Oxboro, so he shouldn't be too hard to find. Go report your victory!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You did<g id="male_whattheheckBig" /> what, with a WHAT?! A bear! Now, that takes serious guts. Did you wind up spilling yours in the fight?

Title: Hope in a Bottle
Description: The Lost Pirates of the Riverworn Grotto have stolen Jacob Evans' last shipment of mead, driving him to the brink of despair.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I should. I would, if not for dear Polly. Her business depends on the mead that I bring, but I'm just a porter.
InProgressResponse: Polly deserves better than me. Someone strong, brave, and true of heart.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My… mead? I can't believe my eyes.

Title: No Time for Wine
Description: With his mead returned, Jacob Evans turns his attention to his next source of woe: a shipment of missing wine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Look at me, friend. A lonely man with his wits barely about him, marching from one town to the next on his own two legs.
InProgressResponse: Please, if you can't find the wine, just… leave me to my fate. The mead's not enough to save Polly's bar. Nothing I do is ever enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh my… That's almost every missing bottle. I don't know what to say.

Title: Master and Commandaria
Description: Jacob Evans has remembered the name of one of his tormentors. Help him get some revenge on Admiral Arias.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: This time, it's not about my goods. Someone ought to teach him a lesson.
InProgressResponse: What do the Lost want with my wares? Can they even taste the sweetness of mead?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Um… Let me see the label on that old bottle. It's covered in dust, but this writing… could it be?

Title: Raising the Bar
Description: Jacob is entrusting you with delivering the priceless bottle of Commandaria to Polly's bar, in the hopes that it will save her business.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Certain. I would love to deliver it myself, but I'm content knowing Polly's saved.
InProgressResponse: Polly's livelihood depends on that bottle. Wrap it up, and make sure the label's covered.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Let's see what we have here. Commandaria? From the island of Cyprus?

Title: Cure For What Ails You
Description: The wares that Anwir is hawking seem a little suspect. Nevertheless, he's happy to pay for help "improving" them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Shh! Not so loud! Are you trying to bring the guards down on my head?
InProgressResponse: I need a better name for the product. Anwir's Elixir just doesn't sound impressive enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A fine piece of liver and a perfect ram's horn. You sure you haven't done this before?

Title: The Secret Ingredient
Description: Anwir Hughes is back, with another scheme to "improve" his Ancient Miracle Elixir.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You wound me! Yes, the latest version of the elixir was pungent, but I know how to solve that little problem.
InProgressResponse: Unfortunately, we'll need many flowers for just one bottle of elixir.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Such lovely hydrangeas. You, my friend, have a knack for spotting good potion ingredients.

Title: Potions for the People
Description: Nothing can go wrong with distributing Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir to the people of Everfall, right?
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Who better than you? You've got that heroic look, and you radiate a certain aura of… trustworthiness.
InProgressResponse: If you get cold feet, just remember: there's coin in it for you too.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: As of today, I've sold at least a dozen orders of Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir. They're going faster than I can make them!

Title: Bottle It Up
Description: Try to piece together the strange alchemical recipe, then bring it to a Syndicate alchemist for further study.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [You carefully copy down the legible text from the paper fragment, but it's meaningless on its own. You need more information to make sense of it.]
InProgressResponse: [By itself, this scrap of paper is useless to you. The glass bottles scattered around it may contain some clues.]
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hm? What's that you've got? "Superiora de inferioribus, inferiora de superioribus."

Title: Miner's Keepers
Description: One ill-fated miner's find is another better-fated miner's treasure.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: [The dusty, smeared, badly crumpled parchment appears to be a hand-drawn charcoal map of north-western Everfall.]
InProgressResponse: [The dusty, smeared, badly crumpled parchment appears to be a hand-drawn charcoal map of north-western Everfall.]

Title: The Yearly Convergence
Description: Welcome to the Winter Convergence! Check out the Holiday Huts in the Winter Villages to see what items can be crafted there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: We must chase away cold. First, by warming hearts. {playerName}, are you prepared to do whatever it takes to save Aeternum?
InProgressResponse: Village here has huts. Huts have shiny coins. Trade coins for goods. Many, many goods! They will help your journey.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This year has much waiting for you if you bring warmth back to Aeternum. Winter, cold, and eternal darkness can be held back by you.

Title: Lost Presents
Description: Find one of the many Lost Presents around Aeternum and return it to the Winter Wanderer in the Winter Village.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Collect presents taken by other Yeti and their ice creatures. Devious minds scatter presents all over the island.
InProgressResponse: Have you found wayward presents? Some suspend in air, locked into place by winter magics.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This gift… makes me remember… I was lost on a mountain, in a terrible winter storm.

Title: The Power of Gleamite
Description: Mine a fallen Gleamite Crystal and return it to the Winter Wanderer in the Winter Village.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Tinkling, ringing with the sound of laughter are these crystals. Their heat harms the Winter Warrior as they fall from the sky to light the land.
InProgressResponse: I have marked on your map where a Gleamite Crystal can be found.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Thank you, {playerName}. You have done much, but I am afraid I must ask for more help still. The Winter Warrior must fall.

Title: Forever Winter
Description: Locate the Winter Warrior's spread of the Forever Winter <img src="lyshineui/images/map/icon/pois/winter_warrior" xPadding="0" scale="2.5" yOffset="5.2"></img>and collect his Hailspikes as proof of victory against the chiling threat.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: @0424_2022_WC_04_Proposal_a
InProgressResponse: The Winter Warrior is formidable foe. Take friends, allies, and all you can to defeat him.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: He is defeated! Oh joy, oh beautiful day! A peaceful Convergence is possible now. Should he appear again, you know what to do.

Title: Enter The Arena
Description: Maximus Marcellus invites you to participate in a team versus team extravaganza. \nUse the Activities Menu to queue for a match
ObjectiveProposalResponse: What is the Arena? Why, it is in the grand tradition of my motherland of Rome, it is a battle spectacular of two teams going head-to-head in combat! It requires skill, coordination, and an unshakable mettle to participate.
InProgressResponse: What are you waiting for? Get out there and pummel!  [Use the Activities Menu to queue for a 3v3 match]
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What a show! I was on the edge of my seat the entire time! You, my friend, are a sure addition to the Arena roster. Return to fight any time, you are always welcome here my fearsome champion!

Title: Tenacious Rose
Description: Mysterious Raiders have taken over the ruins of Stonereach Keep where Abigail Rose was living. She's asked you to help figure who they are, why they're here and how she can get rid of them.
PlayerPrompt: "Whoa, easy! You seem a bit jumpy."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Out here, that's a critical trait, lest you wind up Corrupted or Lost!
InProgressResponse: Have you figured out what these trespassers are doing in my Keep? Whatever it takes to get rid of them, I'm up for it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, you dealt that laughing bastard a thrashing? Well done! The wolves finally met a more vicious wolf!

Title: The Lost Scarecrow
Description: Locate Abigail Rose's missing companion, and find any evidence that points to what the Varangian Knights are searching for.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: My partner and I have been watching this camp for some time, and he moved closer to get a better look. Keep hoping for some sign from him, but nothing yet.
InProgressResponse: Stick to the shadows, move slowly... and when the time is right, take them down. That's how we'll get these fools off our land.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Thanks for your help. I'm going to rest here, then take the long way back to the south. Don't want to have any other accidental run-ins with those armored cretins.

Title: Relic Reclamation
Description: Find the notebook carried south by the Varangian Knights by speaking with the apprentice Caoimhe
ObjectiveProposalResponse: To the one who finds this: I have been taken by the Varangians, those cretins who seek to unlock the mysteries of Myrddin's experiments.
InProgressResponse: You must head south. There is a woman there, Caoimhe, an apprentice to an Antiquarian. She is an ally, and familiar with the magics of the island.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Welcome back! Did you find the notebook for Romac? Wait, he wanted me to have it? If this holds the location to Myrddin's true workshop…
